categories.software: Implementation, operation, and reliability of software systems or data stores.
categories.knowledge: Personal notes, reading highlights, citations, and organization of a knowledge library.
categories.home: Care and organization of a household, its equipment, food, plants, or paper documents.
categories.travel: Planning journeys and protecting travel documents, maps, routes, or photographs.
categories.research: Designing studies, collecting research observations, evaluating methods, and handling participant data.
categories.workplace: Coordinating employees, meetings, tasks, access, and team priorities.

tags.privacy: Protects sensitive or identifying information through minimization, restricted access, redaction, or not sending it to outsiders.
tags.backup: Creates or verifies recoverable copies of digital files or databases. Alternative travel routes and a rebuildable search cache alone do not count.
tags.offline: Explicitly supports or verifies an activity without an internet or mobile network connection.
tags.maintenance: Describes recurring scheduled inspection, upkeep, repair, cleanup, inventory review, or a restoration drill for equipment, software, documents, food stores, or plants. Routine copying or checking a newly captured file alone does not count; explicitly rehearsing restoration does.
